messages:
mari: Hey team — quick check on NimbusBio customer story. They sent back a revised quote and legal redlines. We need final approval before Friday so we can line up the launch post + webinar mention.

leo: Got it. Can you drop the quote + redlines here? I can do a pass on messaging and the launch post copy.

mari: Pasting the customer-provided quote and the legal redline summary from the doc: https://docs.google.com/... (shared with the customer).

mari: Customer quote (original): 
> \"Redwood Inference cut our inference latency by 3x and reduced per-request cost by ~40% — game changer for us.\"

mari: Customer redline asks to remove the exact percent and change to: 
> \"Redwood Inference significantly improved our latency and cut costs, which made deployment feasible for our team.\"

jana-legal: Quick note — customer requested the change and added a clause about not publishing internal benchmark details. That's fine, but we should confirm we don't add any extra numbers in the launch post or slides. Also need an explicit approval from their legal counsel on the final wording (they said they can get to it by Thu EOD).

oliver-cs: @mari @jana-legal I confirmed with NimbusBio CS that they prefer the softer phrasing. They said the 3x/40% numbers came from a bench we did under specific config; they don't want that public.

sophia: For the launch post and webinar, we can keep a short explainer like: 
\"NimbusBio reduced inference latency and costs using Redwood Inference, enabling faster model iterations and broader production rollout.\"

leo: That reads safe. If they sign off on the wording we can pair it with a high-level chart (no raw numbers) and a customer quote card.

mari: Action items: 
- Wait for legal signoff from NimbusBio (Thu EOD) 
- Jana to OK final copy wording on Redwood side 
- Leo to draft launch post and webinar slide snippet (no numbers) by Thu morning 
- Oliver to get PR/CS alignment and customer approval on asset imagery

jana-legal: I can approve from Redwood side once the customer legal confirms. Also, can we get the customer to sign the standard case study release? I sent the doc this morning.

oliver-cs: They said yes to the release, just waiting on their signature flow. I'll ping them now.

assets-bot: Reminder — asset checklist for customer story: high-res headshots, customer logo (white + color), short quote card, 2 slide screenshots, thumbnail image. Upload to /shared/marketing/assets/nimbusbio/

leo: Drafted a short hero line for the launch post: 
\"How NimbusBio scaled model inference and accelerated delivery with Redwood Inference\"

mari: Love it. Leo — please avoid implying specific % improvements. Also include a CTA to the webinar signup.

leo: Will do. Annotating draft with a placeholder where the approved quote will go: 
```
Hero headline...
Subhead...
\"{APPROVED_QUOTE}\" — NimbusBio
\nWebinar CTA: Register here -> https://events.example.com/nimbusbio
```

mari: Timeline check — if we have final customer legal signoff Thu EOD and the signed release, we can: 
- Thu night: publish launch post embargoed (marketing queue) 
- Fri morning: go live + announce + run webinar promotion for next week

oliver-cs: Chased the customer legal again. ETA Thu 4pm their time. They'll confirm the quote wording in that thread.

jana-legal: All good. Also keep the internal benchmark appendix in the playbook but marked "internal only". Do not share that externally.

mari: Thanks everyone. I'll update the shared doc with Leo's copy and drop the approved quote placeholder. Ping here once the signed release lands. :thumbsup: 

oliver-cs: Signed release just came in — uploading scanned copy now. They still want the wording without numbers, approved by their counsel.

mari: Great — Jana, can you do final Redwood signoff on the wording?

jana-legal: Reviewing now. If it's the phrasing we discussed (no numbers), Redwood approves. Sending the signoff comment in the doc.

mari: Perfect. Closing loop: Leo, finalize launch post and slides with approved quote (soft phrasing). I'll schedule an embargoed publish for Thu 11:59pm PT.

leo: On it. Will post draft here when ready for quick review.

mari: Thanks team — nice move getting this through.
